name: 37932 · Knoxville, TN
findings: ZIP 37932 (Knoxville) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37932 (Knoxville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
